name: rrrutledge-claude-code-plugins
description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins by Russell Rutledge

plugins.name: browser-chauffeur
plugins.description: Navigate and interact with ANY website - admin panels, dashboards, web apps, etc. Handles authentication, login session persistence, and autonomous error recovery. Use for checking websites, looking up information, verifying access, or creating automation scripts. Claude drives, you direct.

plugins.name: revealjs
plugins.description: Create polished, professional reveal.js presentations with themes, multi-column layouts, code highlighting, charts, animations, and speaker notes. Generates HTML + CSS with no build step required.

plugins.name: trello
plugins.description: The Trello API client for any board: read or write cards, comments, labels, checklists, and lists, plus the blocked-card dependency model, through trello_utils.py - never the REST API directly. The outreach-funnel process layer over these mechanics is the separate trello-outreach plugin.

plugins.name: trello-outreach
plugins.description: The outreach-funnel process layer over Trello: when and why to open, advance, dedupe, and route cards across the outreach boards, plus the board registry and initiative model. The Trello API mechanics (card/comment/label/checklist CRUD, the client library) are the separate `trello` plugin.

plugins.name: marketing-confluence-page
plugins.description: Create marketing-style Confluence pages with alternating two-column sections (text + image), a hero intro, and a full-width CTA. Used for feature announcements, onboarding guides, and platform documentation.

plugins.name: message-draft
plugins.description: Draft a message in the active web composer — Teams chat or Outlook-web email reply — via browser automation. Stages a draft in the correct conversation and NEVER sends. Supersedes teams-message.

plugins.name: document-authoring
plugins.description: Russell's personal style conventions for authoring or editing documents and messages with links or formatted prose.

plugins.name: screenshot
plugins.description: Auto-loads the most recent Windows screenshot when user references a screenshot without providing a file path.

plugins.name: ms-graph
plugins.description: Read/write a personal Microsoft account's Outlook mail and calendar via the Microsoft Graph API (official @azure/msal-node + @microsoft/microsoft-graph-client). List/create calendar events, search/read mail, draft replies, or send yourself a note — no browser after a one-time sign-in.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Read/draft/clear a personal Gmail or Google Workspace mailbox via IMAP using a Google app password — no OAuth app, no Cloud project, no browser. List the inbox, show a message, move mail to Trash, or stage reply/new drafts in Drafts (never sent).

plugins.name: google-docs
plugins.description: Read/write Google Docs content (table rows, paragraphs, hyperlinks) via the Docs API — no browser. Append or delete table rows, and set a cell to plain text, a bulleted list, or a short clickable hyperlink. Reuses the gmail plugin's OAuth client with a separate token scoped to the documents API.

plugins.name: google-sheets
plugins.description: Append rows to a Google Sheet, or read a range's values, via the Sheets API — no browser. Reuses the gmail plugin's OAuth client with a separate token scoped to the spreadsheets API.

plugins.name: mail-filters
plugins.description: Russell's calibrated strategy for mail filters/rules that auto-archive never-process mail at the server before it reaches the drainer. Teaches the phrase-selection craft (broad enough to recur across senders, strict enough to never bury wanted mail) and the create/delete mechanics for Gmail filters and Outlook rules.

plugins.name: slack
plugins.description: Read and mark-read a Slack workspace via the Slack Web API. List unread DMs, group DMs, @-mentions, and unread thread replies (muted conversations skipped), show a message with its permalink, read recent thread/channel history, or mark a conversation or thread read. No browser; reply drafting is handled separately by the message-draft skill.

plugins.name: safe-compounds
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that auto-approves compound bash commands whose every segment is already trusted, enforces CLAUDE.md style rules (no heredocs, redirection, inline scripts), and classifies MCP and Write/Edit calls — keeping long Claude Code sessions prompt-free without --dangerously-skip-permissions.

plugins.name: drainer
plugins.description: Drain human-touch queues (email, Teams, Slack, Trello outreach) to zero with one shared loop: read each item, do the action it implies, draft any reply in your voice (draft-only, never sent), and clear it. Per-machine sources and context come from .claude/drainer.local.md.

plugins.name: ms-rest
plugins.description: Read, delete, and compose Outlook mail and calendar events for a WORK Microsoft account via the Outlook REST API — no browser needed after a one-time sign-in (token sniffed from the live Outlook web session).

plugins.name: teams
plugins.description: Read Microsoft Teams chats and watched-team channels via the Teams internal REST services with tokens sniffed from the live Teams web session. List unread DMs, group chats, meeting chats, and watched-team channels, and read a conversation's messages — no DOM hydration. Mark-read and reply drafting are browser-driven (drainer worker + message-draft skill).

plugins.name: session-mgr
plugins.description: Find and resume Claude Code sessions that ended abruptly — after a restart, crash, or unplanned shutdown. Scans all sessions across every working directory and opens each one in a new Windows Terminal tab.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Russell's git/GitHub workflow rules — branching from main, when PRs merge, closing PRs and branch cleanup, code review timing, repo deletion, gh CLI usage, PR link formatting. Use whenever creating a branch/commit/PR, merging, closing, or reviewing a PR, or doing any other git/gh operation.
